verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own materials say you can "connect your calendars" and list Google Calendar and Apple Calendar apps. The Outlook app explicitly says it will "check your Outlook calendar for conflicts", and availability is computed from busy-time calculations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Google and Apple calendars are also checked for conflicts, explicit confirmation that several connected calendars are checked at the same time, and independent or hands-on corroboration that double-booking is prevented.
